title: Linear Preservers of Infinitely Divisible Matrices
summary: An infinitely divisible nonnegative matrix is an entry-wise nonnegative matrix that admits an entry-wise nonnegative $m$th root, with respect to usual matrix multiplication, for every positive integer $m$; it is called strongly infinitely divisible when it is, in addition, invertible.
